name: A Means to Escape
source:
It is at this moment written that every single one of the Test Subjects/Specimens from #0001 to #3000 be locked in their rooms after every round of testing and medical checkups. They cannot interact with one another in any shape or form.

Every single guard and researcher in this facility must make sure that they do not interact, especially subjects #0045, #0998, #1045, and #2777.
-- General Instruction #003.

It is at this moment written that confraternization with the Test Subjects/Specimens in any form is forbidden. Do not interact with them more than necessary and only talk to them when authorized.
-- General Instruction #033.

A Means to Escape is a short visual novel made for the 02A2 VN Jam 2023 about wanting to be free before death and trying to defy a shadowy organization.
It's also a little gay.

[From [url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/a-means-to-escape]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
此刻，从 #0001到 #3000的每一个测试对象/样本在每一轮测试和体检后都被锁在自己的房间里。他们不能以任何形式或方式彼此互动。

该设施中的每一位警卫和研究人员都必须确保他们不会互动，尤其是对象#0045、#0998、#1045和#2777。
-- 一般说明 #003。

目前已明确禁止与测试对象/样本进行任何形式的交往。不要与他们进行不必要的互动，并且仅在获得授权的情况下才与他们交谈。
-- 一般说明 #033。

《逃脱之道》是一部为02A2 VN Jam 2023创作的短篇视觉小说，讲述了想要在死前获得自由并试图反抗一个神秘组织的故事。
这也有点同性恋。

[来自[url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/a-means-to-escape]itch.io[/url]]
